name: Being
source:
Main character is shown a mysterious adult toys show one day. Instruments there are of unknown usage and effect. He goes on a trip and uses these items on the girls he meets.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-august-2001-kimi-ga-nozomu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
有一天，主角參觀了一場神秘的情趣用品展。展出的器具究竟該怎麼用、會產生什麼效果，全都不得而知。他帶著這些東西踏上旅途，在途中遇見的女孩身上逐一試用。
